name: browser-harness-js
description: Drive any Chromium-based browser via the DevTools Protocol from JavaScript.

interface.shortDescription: Drive Chromium from JS via CDP
interface.longDescription: The thinnest possible bridge from the LLM to Chrome: one persistent WebSocket, 56 domains, 652 typed CDP wrappers, and a folder of pure-CDP interaction recipes. Drives the user's OWN Chromium browser — inherit-free login state, no bundled browser.
defaultPrompt: Open a website and inspect the page via the accessibility tree.
